x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Use ripgrep glob options or enumerate exact repository paths before one bounded multi-file search.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: Ripgrep returned operating-system error 123 for each wildcard path and the inventory earned zero complete-set credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Search mechanically copied x2 scripts and tests using positional star patterns in PowerShell.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: The first x2 scaffold inventory passed Windows wildcard filenames as positional ripgrep paths, which returned invalid-path syntax after only the exact config preview.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The enumerated v657-v2 scaffold inventory completed and exposed the exact source, count, domain, and route fields requiring adaptation.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Enumerate v657-v2 paths with rg --files, filter the exact list, and pass that bounded set to the inspection step.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never pass an unexpanded Windows wildcard as a positional filename to ripgrep; bind -g patterns or exact paths.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Owner-local read-only x2 scaffold inventory recovery only.

x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Remove only the newly created untracked lifecycle copies and rematerialize each layer after its required predecessor commit is immutable.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: Ten premature Ilyra-only untracked files existed with predecessor anchors and had no evidence or lifecycle credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Mechanically copy all predecessor lifecycle files immediately after the x1 gate without first partitioning them by immutable-anchor dependency.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: The first mechanical x2 scaffold copy also created untracked closeout and final files before their immutable evidence and closeout anchors existed.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The evidence candidate contains no closeout or final scaffold; those layers remain deferred until their exact anchors exist.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Delete only those ten untracked Ilyra copies, retain all committed and sibling files untouched, and keep only evidence-layer scaffolds.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Copy lifecycle scaffolds just in time: evidence surfaces after x1, closeout after evidence, and final surfaces after closeout.

x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Apply ASCII-safe fixture-field hunks first, inspect the exact UTF-8 line, then patch the boundary prose separately.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: Patch verification rejected the mixed hunk before mutation and granted zero edit credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Submit one patch containing fixture keys and a terminal-rendered Māori boundary line.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: A mixed structural-field and human-readable runtime patch did not match the inherited UTF-8 boundary line and changed nothing.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The runtime now uses lift-domain fixture fields and exact UTF-8 authority prose while preserving unrelated validation logic.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Patch machine fields at ASCII anchors, inspect the UTF-8 source through Python, and apply a narrow exact-text hunk.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine structural fields with terminal-rendered Unicode context when adapting lifecycle scaffolds.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Owner-local runtime scaffold adaptation recovery only.

x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Compile and run the x2 builder after changing constructor and required-key sets but before checking the independent boolean-key loop.

x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: All valid fixtures completed the aligned fail-closed key checks before surface evidence was written.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Replace all three stale loop keys with their lift-domain counterparts and run the same thirty-surface builder.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Search every schema key across constructors, required-key sets, validation loops, mutations, and tests after a domain rename.
